description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is a technology and consulting company that delivers technical and industry expertise to public and private sector clients. The Associate Application Developer will build Salesforce development capabilities through structured learning, certifications, mentorship, and hands-on client experience while configuring, customizing, integrating, maintaining, and optimizing Salesforce solutions.
Salesforce application developer configuring CRM workflows, developing Apex and Lightning components, and integrating enterprise systems

Responsibilities:
• Configure and Administer Salesforce: Learn to configure and administer the Salesforce platform to meet business requirements, ensuring efficient workflow and data management using tools like the Force.com IDE and Data Loader
• Develop Apex Code and Visualforce Pages: Build capabilities in writing Apex code and creating Visualforce pages and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to customize and enhance Salesforce functionality
• Integrate with Enterprise Applications: Gain experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications, ensuring seamless data flow and synchronization to provide a unified user experience
• Maintain and Optimize Salesforce: Perform routine maintenance and optimization tasks to ensure platform efficiency and user adoption

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Currently completing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
• Foundational knowledge of programming languages and core software engineering principles
• Understanding of software development fundamentals, APIs, databases, cloud computing, and application architectures
• Exposure to web applications, software development, or enterprise platforms through coursework, projects, research, or internships
• Familiarity with version control tools such as Git
• Curiosity about enterprise technology, Artificial Intelligence, CRM platforms, automation, and digital transformation
• Travel required: Up to 60% or 3 days a week (home on weekends - based on project requirements)
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Exposure to Salesforce platform configuration, administration, or CRM principles
• Experience or coursework involving Apex code development, Visualforce, or Lightning Web Components (LWC)
• Knowledge of CRM integration principles with enterprise applications
• Interest in Salesforce performance optimization, workflow automation, and cloud-native solutions
